questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with no gates or flashing lights, but with a standard crossbuck sign. What should you do?

options.text: Approach the tracks with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming.
Turn your radio down so you can listen for an approaching train.
Only continue when a flagger tells you it is safe, if one is present.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, obey all their instructions.

questions.question: How often should drivers check their mirrors?
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors about every 10 seconds to watch for vehicles following too closely. Keep your eyes on the road. The vehicle ahead of you could stop suddenly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Drive as you would on dry roads.

questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase your following distance. Your vehicle will take longer to stop than it would on normal roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs that show upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background.
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background.
White letters or symbols on a blue background.
White letters or symbols on a green background.

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black lettering or symbols. Construction zone warning signs are orange with black lettering or symbols.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, what must you do?

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When you leave your vehicle, you must turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at the same time at a four-way intersection with stop signs. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way intersection, if both drivers arrive at the same time, yield to the driver on your right. You can then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What color lines divide lanes of traffic moving in the same direction?
questions.explanation: Solid white lines separate lanes traveling in the same direction and mark the right edge of the road. Broken white lines separate lanes in the same direction and can be crossed when passing safely. Yellow lines separate lanes moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Your headlights are misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You can damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: You may drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You may cross these lines to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Orange signs are:
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are diamond-shaped with orange backgrounds and black letters. They warn drivers that people are working on or near the road.

questions.question: Crossbuck signs indicate:
questions.explanation: Crossbuck signs tell drivers to yield to trains at railroad crossings. Never try to drive faster than a train to cross the tracks.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which one has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle coming from the right.
The vehicle coming from the left.
The vehicle whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle coming from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection without traffic control signs or signals, you must yield to a vehicle approaching from your right.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. Before you move your car, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so the children hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to check the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to check the way is clear.
questions.explanation: When backing up, look through your back window for people and obstacles. Do not rely only on mirrors. Always get out and check behind your vehicle before backing up, especially when children are nearby.

questions.question: When approaching an accident scene, you should:

options.text: Stop only if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived.

questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Focus on your driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Never slow down just to look at an accident.

questions.question: If you experience a tire blowout:

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not immediately use your brakes.
Gradually slow down and pull off the side of the road.

questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout, release the gas pedal and do not brake immediately. Gradually slow down and gently apply the brakes before pulling off the side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot yield to cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first to sit comfortably and see the road clearly. Once your seat is set, adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: In winter weather, allow at least ____ the normal stopping distance.
questions.explanation: Snow and ice make roads slippery and increase skidding risk. Use at least three times the normal stopping distance to slow down safely.

questions.question: Many crashes are caused by:

options.text: Drivers traveling too fast for conditions.
Drivers checking their mirrors and blind spots.
Drivers maintaining a four-second following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers traveling too fast for conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen when drivers go too fast for road conditions. Always drive within speed limits and slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: You should be cautious when passing a bicycle because:

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing bicycles because cyclists may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid obstacles. Always drive carefully around cyclists.

questions.question: Which of these affect how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: The amount of food in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how fast you drink, and your weight. Food slows alcohol absorption but does not prevent intoxication.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question:
If you get seven points on your driver license, what may happen?
    I. You must file proof of financial responsibility.
    II. You can remove three points by completing a driver improvement clinic.
questions.explanation: At seven points, you may be required to attend a driver improvement clinic with a $65 fee. If you complete it successfully, three points are removed from your record.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign mean?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs with black symbols warn drivers about construction, maintenance, and emergency work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead and to watch for trains.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: If power steering fails, you will need extra force to steer. Reduce your speed and pull off the road to stop safely.
